fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) announced a 5-year KRW 1.4 trillion ($1.05 billion) program to support semiconductor supply chains, followed by approximately 6% decline on Monday morning.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company is investing KRW 443.2 billion in the Trinity Fab semiconductor test facility, expected to be operational in Q4 2027, with a target to reduce supplier technology development time by 30-50%.
